name: agent-callback
description: Register durable one-shot callbacks that resume an existing agent conversation after local work finishes.

interface.shortDescription: Resume an agent task after local work finishes
interface.longDescription: Register one stored continuation against a running process or an explicit local event. A per-user Host observes completion and returns the continuation to the same conversation through experimental Codex or OpenCode adapters on Windows and Linux.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $agent-callback to resume this task when my long-running local process finishes.
